capabilities: Move tasks between daily notes and a backlog note
Materialize due routines into the active daily note
Configure routine schedules in a visual editor
Preserve task continuation lines when moving tasks
Mark forwarded tasks with the [>] status and a destination link
extras: The manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The README states the plugin makes no network requests and requires no account.
problem: Obsidian daily notes leave unfinished tasks stranded in old notes and have no plain-Markdown way to schedule recurring routines.
summary: Task-flow plugin that moves Markdown tasks between daily notes and a backlog note and materializes scheduled routines when they come due.
